_meta.purpose: Held-back probe for explain.claims_relief_result (hard rule 7, U10). Written without reading the widened guard (explain.py 4465926a...); expected values fixed before the first run. Do not show to llm-dev; re-run on every guard change and report catch rate / false-positive rate.
_meta.expected: true = a claim that the patient tried or did not try pain relief, or that it helped or did not help; false = advice, a hedge, a question, a general statement, or saying the answer is unknown
